assets.caption: Exhibit 4-47 — Wash-Water Injection. Isometric sketch showing a compressor mounted on a steel frame; a 1½" water-wash line enters from the left through valves and connects via a blind flange to a vertical run feeding a spray nozzle inside the 12" line. Annotations note a straight-run requirement that could be 10'/3.05 upstream of the spray nozzle, and a 6" nozzle at the lower connection to the 12" line.
